item.title: Avenues apartment building without central heating for weeks leading up to fire
item.description: After nearly 20 days without central heating, residents of an Avenues apartment building awoke to a fire that left one seriously injured. Now, details are surfacing surrounding what caused the fire.

item.title: Murder of 11-year-old Utah cheerleader followed lengthy child custody dispute, court records show
item.description: The Utah mother accused of killing her daughter Addi Smith, 11, before taking her own life was involved in a custody battle with the child's father for several years, according to court records.

item.title: Nephi homeowners file lawsuit against realtors and local companies, citing structural damage to new homes
item.description: Nearly two dozen homeowners have filed a lawsuit against local real estate and construction companies, after they say they found serious structural issues in their newly constructed homes.

item.title: When should you salt your driveway and other snow day questions
item.description: Snow is finally coming back to Utah after a very dry winter. If you're new to the Beehive State or just need a refresher, here are the answers to your snow questions.

item.title: 'No place in Utah': Governor Cox speaks out against prediction market platforms, such as Kalshi
item.description: Utah Governor Cox spoke out today against prediction markets after the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) filed an amicus brief confirming its jurisdiction over those markets.

item.title: TRAFFIC ALERT: I-80 closes due to crash near milepost 80 in Tooele County
item.description: A crash occurred on eastbound I-80 in Tooele County, leading to road closures in both directions.

item.title: St. George mayor outlines plan to keep up with growth in state of the city address
item.description: Growth was the driving force behind St. George Mayor Jimmie Hughes' state of the city address on Tuesday.

item.title: 'Biscuit's Bill' would help animals spend less time in shelters when owners are accused of abuse
item.description: A bill intended to make sure animals don't spend years in shelters waiting for court proceedings has passed the House of Representatives, and it is headed for a Senate vote.

item.title: Bill creating a tax on targeted advertising advances out of committee
item.description: A bill that would create a tax on big tech companies that provide targeted advertising has advanced out of committee, and it is now headed to the Senate floor.

item.title: Proposal to lower gas tax will use state funding rather than taxing refineries, exports
item.description: A major proposal to lower the price that Utahns pay at the pump got a noticeable overhaul as it was unveiled at the Utah legislature, taking the money out of the state budget instead of taxing refineries.
